posts.text:
The President cut your health care so that he could build a paramilitary force that is accountable only to him.

It’s alarming and it’s wrong.
Blessed Palm Sunday. May this Holy Week bring reflection, peace, and renewed faith.

It's already illegal to vote if you're not a citizen.

They're trying to convince us there are droves of people who are willing to risk deportation and the abuse that we are seeing from ICE to vote illegally.

It defies credulity and it's simply not true.

This shouldn’t be controversial.

Defunding cancer research to pay for corporate tax cuts is twisted and wrong.

It was inspiring to see folks in Atlanta this morning speak up, organize, and remind this administration that power still belongs to the people.

No kings in America.

Video

This war is not slowing the President down. 
 
He is full steam ahead on his number one goal of ripping health care away from millions of Americans here at home.

Why does the President keep saying that his voter suppression bill is his number one priority?

Because he knows he has failed.
He knows the people have turned against him.
So he has to change the rules.
Republicans in DC only want the "right people" to vote.

The SAVE Act is not a voter ID bill. It's a voter suppression bill.

Let me break it down for you.

Video
Donald Trump would rather change the rules than change his failed and unpopular policies.

Outrageous.

I just learned that Republicans in DC are apparently considering MORE cuts to health care in order to fund war in Iran.

That's unacceptable and a non-starter. No more cuts to health care.

They're determined to find a problem that does not exist.

Video

This is not a headline that should ever have to be written in the richest country on earth.
 nitter.net/senatorbaldwin/status/…


Sen. Tammy Baldwin (@SenatorBaldwin)

What Donald Trump has spent on his war in just 3 weeks is what it would have cost to extend the Affordable Care Act tax credits for 1 year.

Trump has messed up on affordability so badly that he’s even managed to make the mail more expensive. nitter.net/MorePerfectUS/status/2…


More Perfect Union (@MorePerfectUS)

BREAKING: USPS will impose its first-ever surcharge on packages — an 8% fee to cover the rising cost of fuel.



— https://nitter.net/MorePerfectUS/status/2036885743574868031#m

The fact that some in this country are forced to ration insulin is a moral failure.
 
My colleagues and I just introduced legislation to cap the cost of insulin.
 
In the richest country on earth, EVERYONE who needs insulin should be able to get it. It's as simple as that.

9 times in 3 weeks.

That's how many times Republicans in DC have blocked funding for TSA.

The chaos at the airports needs to stop and TSA agents need to be paid now.

Enough with the games. Fund TSA.
The SAVE America Act is designed to save one thing and one thing only: Donald Trump's power.

We all agree TSA workers should be getting paid. So what's the hold up? Fund TSA now.

Video

Instead of sending a paramilitary force into our airports, the President should simply tell Republicans in the Senate to fund TSA.


Sefenech Henok (@SefenechHenokTV)
